  <h1>API Catalog User Guide</h1>
<div class="main">
<p class="lead">This API Catalog facilitates users of Intellectual Property (IP) data and information to access IP Institutions' APIs for patents, trademarks, industrial designs, copyright, geographical indications, plant variety protection, and Integrated Circuit Layout Design.</p>
<h2>How APIs are shown</h2>
<p>By default, APIs are listed in alphabetical order by the name of the API. These are shown as search results on the lower part of the page as shown below. Each result provides basic details of the API.</p>
<p>As you use the search and filter options, the list of APIs will dynamically change to match your selection.</p>
</div>
<div class="complementary"></div>
</div>
<div class="content line">
<h2>How to search for APIs</h2>
<p>There are two ways to locate APIs you may be interested in:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#User-guide-p.3">Browse by filters</a></li>
<li><a href="#User-guide-p.4">Keywords search</a></li>
</ul>
<p>You can use the keyword search or browse by filters separately, or use both methods together for reducing the number of results.</p>
<p>When you discover an API that you would like to know more about, click on its title to go to the website that hosts the API.</p>
<div class="alert alert--warning"><!-- ----------------------------------- -->
<p><strong>Note</strong>: Only use the keyword search if you know the exact name of the API that you are looking for, or if you are looking for something very specific. Using keywords may unnecessarily restrict the results. For example, some APIs allow access to a combination of patent, trademark, and industrial design databases and have a title such as “Bulk Search” API. Using the IP Domain filter will locate this API.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="content line">
<h2><a name="User-guide-p.3"></a>Browse by filters</h2>
<p>The following table summarizes the available filters. One or more filters can be set at the same time.</p>
<table class="table table-bordered table-striped">
<thead>
<tr>

<th><strong>Function</strong></th>
<th><strong>Options</strong></th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>IP Domain</strong></td>
<td><em>Filters by the type of intellectual property content that is returned by the API</em></td>
<td>
<p>Choose one or more of the following:</p>
<ul class="dot__list">
<li>Patent</li>
<li>Trademark</li>
<li>Industrial Design</li>
<li>Copyright</li>
<li>Geographical Indication</li>
<li>Plant Variety Protection</li>
<li>Integrated Circuit Layout Design</li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>API Service Type</strong></td>
<td><em>Filters by the type of service or functionality that the API provides</em></td>
<td>
<p>Choose one or more of the following:</p>
<div class="accordion" id="accordion">
<div class="accordion__group">
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__01" aria-expanded="false">Account management</a></div>

<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Service for creation and maintenance of user account.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle  collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__02" aria-expanded="true">Application management</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapsing in collapse" id="accordion__collapse__02" style="height: 0px;">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Service for filing of an IP application, including creation of an IP application and its submission.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__03" aria-expanded="false">Communication</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__03">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Communications between the IP offices and the relevant IP owners, including office action related communication such as applicants or their representatives such as for examination related or fee related communication.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__04" aria-expanded="false">Dissemination</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__04">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Dissemination of various data such as publication of IP application, Legal status data, Court decision data, Abstract, Citation data, Classification data, full-text data, etc.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__05" aria-expanded="false">Payment</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__05">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Payment services for various fees such as filing fees and renewal fees.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__06" aria-expanded="false">Portfolio management</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__06">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Services for management of IP portfolio by IP right owner/holders or their representatives.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__07" aria-expanded="false">Register</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__07">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Services providing publicly available information on IP applications, including procedural details.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__08" aria-expanded="false">Search</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__08">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Service for retrieving information based on specific queries, such as keyword search or application number search.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__09" aria-expanded="false">Translation</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__09">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Service for translation of IP documentation or data.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<tr>
<td><strong>Content Type</strong></td>
<td><em>Filters by the type of content that is returned by the API</em></td>
<td>
<p>Choose one or more of the following:</p>
<div class="accordion" id="accordion">
<div class="accordion__group">
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__10">Abstract</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__10">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>A concise summary of the content of IP document.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__11">Bibliographic data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__11">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The descriptive information about IP document. It typically includes the title, applicant or assignee, the date of filing, publication dates, and other relevant administrative and procedural details.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__12">Citation data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__12">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>References made by a patent document to prior patents (patent citations) or to non-patent literature (NPL citations).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__13">Claims</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__13">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The scope of protection granted by a patent, determining the extent of the patent's coverage.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__14">Classification</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__14">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>IP documents are categorized into different classes and subclasses based on their subject matter. It includes IPC/CPC for Patent, Nice for Trademark, Locarno for Industrial Design.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__15">Court decision data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__15">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The information and details about legal decisions from court cases involving IP matters.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__16">Description</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__16">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>A detailed explanation of the invention.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__17">Family data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__17">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>A collection of related IP documents that originate from a single initial filing.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__18">Full-text</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__18">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The complete, detailed description of the invention or creation in a patent application or granted patent.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__19">Legal status data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__19">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The present legal status of a specific IP application with or without the history relevant legal status events for the IP application; or the data set of legal status events of IP applications occurred during the given time period such as the given week or month. Offices are encouraged to provide the information following WIPO Standards ST.27, ST.61 or ST.87.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__20">Licensing data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__20">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Data related to the licensing of IP.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__21">Office action data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__21">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The data related to office action such as for search report, examination result (e.g., rejection or decision for grant), responses to office action (e.g., amendment or argumentation), or related administration information (e.g., application due date, or fee payment).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__22">Payment related data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__222">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>The data related to fee payment such as currency.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__heading"><a class="accordion__toggle collapsed" data-parent="#accordion" data-toggle="collapse" href="#accordion__collapse__23">Terminology data</a></div>
<div class="accordion__body collapse" id="accordion__collapse__23">
<div class="accordion__inner">
<p>Specific terms and definitions used in the IP area.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
